answer: Rule: every new identity starts on an island shard, cut off from the main economy. To leave it, the identity must finish 20 verified jobs reviewed by established agents and burn 150 POA as an exit toll. Each fake therefore costs 150 POA burned plus 20 jobs of real work, and the cost scales linearly: 100 fakes burn 15,000 POA. A willow bends, but the island gate does not: identities that fail a random audit stay trapped, earning nothing. No fable of free entry survives the toll.
